units: <cite ref="Ketubot 73b:16">Keth. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>אין חֲזָרָתָהּ ח׳ גמורה</he> her return (as a minor, to her husband after divorce, i.e. her remarriage) is not fully valid.
<cite ref="Chullin 116b:12">Ḥull. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>קידם ח׳</he> before the editor of the Mishnah had changed his opinion.
Yeb. 64ᵇ אבין ישנו בח׳ Abin (being constantly with R. Joh.) is aware of an eventual change of his teacher’s opinion; [oth. explan.: is in the habit of reviewing his traditions).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:7:2">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᶜ</cite> top <he>ויבדק ויחזור בו ח׳ גמורה</he> and he is examined and gives evidence of true reformation; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:7:2">ib.</cite> <he>חֲזִירַת ממון לא חֲזָרַת דברים</he> (by which is meant) restoration of ill-gotten gain, not a mere return in words; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 7:4:1">Y. Shebu. VII, 37ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:6">Snh. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>חֲזָרַת ממון</he>.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 24a:6">M. Kat. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>חֲזָרַת קרע לאחוריו</he> turning the rent in the mourner’s garment inside (during the Sabbath); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:7">Gen. R. s. 100</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5:19">Y. M. Kat. III, 82ᵈ</cite> bot. <cite ref="H00542"><he>חֲזִירַת</he></cite>.
